RDFXMLParserTest#testFatalErrorDoctypeDe.spec: XML 1.0 (Fifth Edition) section 2.8 [22] prolog ::= XMLDecl? Misc* (doctypedecl Misc*)? and section 5.1 (a non-validating processor need not read external parameter entities); RDF 1.2 XML Syntax section 2 (an RDF/XML document is an XML document)
RDFXMLParserTest#testFatalErrorDoctypeDe.note: RDF4J refuses any DOCTYPE by default (XMLParserSettings.DISALLOW_DOCTYPE_DECL=true, an XXE hardening choice). The document is well-formed XML; Factoidal skips the unread external parameter entity and gives the one triple <http://example.org/foo/bar> rdfs:label "Foo Bar".
